text: Appointed President of the Johnson & Johnson Spring House Intern & Co-Op Association, after previously serving as Vice President.

Presented "Optimizing PGC LC Ion Mobility Mass Spectrometry for Structural Characterization of Cancer-Related N-Linked Glycans" as a poster and poster highlight talk at Cancer Glyco X-2026, Van Andel Institute.
Presented "Structural and Mechanistic Characterization of AprL, a PLP-Dependent Aminotransferase in Apramycin Biosynthesis" at ACS Spring 2026, Atlanta.
Named one of three finalists for the 2026 Women in Chemicals Woman of the Year Award.
Elected as a Full Member of Sigma Xi, The Scientific Research Honor Society.
